notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three land cards in hand.
You control an artifact, creature and/or land that can produce at least {U}, and one that can produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a land card.
Slogurk's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping an applicable permanent that can produce at least {U} and/or {G}.
Activate the mana producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U} and/or {G}.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Slogurk leaves the battlefield, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
